technology_name: A MULTI-LAYERED GRAPHENE ENCAPSULATED HIGH-ENTROPY ALLOY REINFORCED METAL MATRIX COMPOSITE AND METHODS OF FABRICATION THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard aluminum components used in extreme structural settings face severe friction wear, low fatigue lifespans, structural cracking under high impact, and elevated thermal degradation boundaries.
description: An advanced metallurgical manufacturing method to produce high-strength AA7075 metal matrix structural profiles reinforced with multi-layered graphene-encapsulated high-entropy alloy (HEA) particles, improving tensile strength, impact margins, and chemical corrosion resistance.
applications: Aerospace structural airframe components, high-load automotive chassis parts, specialized military vehicle protective paneling, and heavy industrial machinery structural links.
